group "Backend" {

  C
}
A->B: msg

```

ZenUML syntax: call with nested block `A->B.method() { C.other() }`; assign `x = B.get()`; `if (cond) { } else { }`; `return x`; `// comment`; participants `@Actor User`, `@Database DB`; quote names with spaces or slashes `B."GET /x"()`. Mistakes: no `{ }` block after an async `A->B: text` message (use `A->B.method() { }`); `group Name { A B }` only wraps participant declarations, so it goes before the first message and holds no messages.
